title: Stripe Xero Integration: How to Set It Up (2026 Guide)
summary: Stripe Xero integration is fastest with the official app for standard reconciliation. Determine if custom workflows suit your additional needs.
body_markdown:
## Stripe app setup for Xero in four stages


With the Xero accounts and bank feed confirmed, setup is four stages, and each one ends with something you can check before moving on. Follow Stripe's current install docs for exact button labels, since the interface changes.


Start by installing the app from the[Stripe](https://stripe.com/invoicing/pricing) dashboard's app marketplace, then authorise the Xero organisation when prompted.


Choose the right organisation here. If you manage several Xero files, a wrong pick sends every later sync to the wrong ledger. The stage is done when the app shows your Xero organisation by name.


### Stage 2: Map accounts and set the start date


Map each Stripe item to a Xero account: sales, Stripe fees, and the clearing account that receives payouts. Then set the sync start date to the first day of an open period, not the day you installed.


If the start date falls inside a period you've already closed, the app tries to post into it, and you'll see the failure at month end instead of today.


The stage is done when every mapping holds a real account and the date falls in an open period.


### Stage 3: Run the first sync and check one payout


Run the first sync and pick one payout to trace end to end. Compare the Xero total with the Stripe payout total. They should agree to the cent. If they don't, stop and fix the mapping before syncing anything else.


Expect that payout to arrive late. Typical default schedules, as listed by[Rock Gym Pro](https://support.rockgympro.com/hc/en-us/articles/12828864121997-Stripe-Custom-Payout-Schedule-by-Country) , are 2 business days in the US, UK and Australia, so a Monday charge usually reconciles by Wednesday. According to[Support](https://support.rockgympro.com/hc/en-us/articles/12828864121997-Stripe-Custom-Payout-Schedule-by-Country) , **Canada is 3 business days** .


Rock Gym Pro notes that New Zealand is 4, and Singapore is 7, so a Singapore payout can sit unmatched for more than a week without anything being wrong.


That's a third-party list, so confirm your own country against Stripe's payout documentation and note the date you checked.


### Stage 4: Reconcile the payout in Xero


Open the bank feed in Xero and find the deposit. Match it to the synced payout, which should carry the gross sales and the fees as separate lines.


The stage is done when the deposit reconciles with no manual adjustment. If it needs one, the cause is almost always a mapping or a start date, so go back to Stage 2.
